title: Finite affine local representatives at a common stage
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps, and $c$ a limiting cone with apex $X$ and projections $p_j$. Fix $i_0\in I$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on the small étale site of $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and an affine étale object $W$ over $D(i_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Index the upper tail by objects $j$ of $\mathrm{Over}(op\,i_0)$, with structure map $f_j:D(j)\to D(i_0)$. Set $H_j=f_j^*G$, $L=p_{i_0}^*G$, $B_j$ equal to base change along $p_j$, $Y_j=f_j^*W$, and let $e_j:p_{i_0}^*W\cong B_jY_j$ be the canonical iterated-fibre-product isomorphism. Put $\beta_j=\beta(p_j,f_j,p_{i_0}):H_j\to(p_j)_*L$ [def-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-comparison]. Fix $t\in L(p_{i_0}^*W)$. There are $j$, $n\in\mathbb N$, affine étale objects $V_q$ over $D(j)$ for $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, arrows $a_q:V_q\to Y_j$ whose generated sieve is covering, and sections $s_q\in H_j(V_q)$, such that $\beta_j(s_q)=L(B_j(a_q)\circ e_j^{-1})(t)$, where compositions are written in diagrammatic order and $L$ restricts contravariantly. The family $s_q$ need not yet be compatible.

proof.text: Use the image sieve of the locally surjective sheafification unit on the pointwise left Kan extension. Apply the proved Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology to obtain a finite affine refinement. Obtain an original section and a map for each member using etaleInverseImageSectionDescription_representation. The test object is affine by Mathlib isAffineHom_π_app and affine base change.

Apply etale_finiteCoverFactorizationDescent to the finite covering and its auxiliary maps. Construct each stage section by applying the stage adjunction unit to the original section and restricting along the descended auxiliary arrow.

The composition-unit equation identifies the comparison on a unit section. Naturality moves restriction along the descended auxiliary arrow through the comparison. The two descended-arrow equations and contravariant functoriality identify the result with restriction of t along the descended covering arrow.

theorem etaleSet_finiteLocalStageRepresentatives
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).FullAffineEtale)
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj W.obj))) :
    let H := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (D.map j.hom)).obj G
    let L := (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj G
    let B := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app j.left)
    let Y := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map j.hom)).obj W.obj
    let e := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤)
        (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom) (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom).symm).app W.obj
    let β := fun j : Over (op i₀) ↦
      etaleSetSheafComparison (c.π.app j.left) (D.map j.hom)
        (c.π.app (op i₀)) (c.w j.hom) G
    ∃ (j : Over (op i₀)) (n : ℕ) (V : Fin n → (D.obj j.left).Etale)
      (a : ∀ q, V q ⟶ Y j) (s : ∀ q, (H j).obj.obj (op (V q))),
      Sieve.ofArrows V a ∈ (D.obj j.left).smallEtaleTopology (Y j) ∧
      (∀ q, IsAffine (V q).left) ∧
      (∀ q, (β j).hom.app (op (V q)) (s q) =
        L.obj.map ((B j).map (a q) ≫ (e j).inv).op t)
